title: Doozy Vape Co Apple & Grape Blast Nicotine Salts
description: Sweet, crisp, clean and refreshing, Doozy Vape Co’s Apple & Grape Blast is an invigorating fusion of tangy fruits and icy menthol. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
